units.source_text: 侍从薰君被称为老实人，心终不甘。

en.t: Lord Kaoru the Chamberlain was known as an honest man, but in his heart he was never quite satisfied with that reputation.

units.source_text: 正月二十过后，梅花盛开之时，他想教嫌他不风流的侍女们看看他的本相，

en.t: After the twentieth day of the first month, when the plum blossoms were in full bloom, he wanted to show his true nature to the ladies who thought him lacking in romantic charm,

units.source_text: 特赴尚侍邸访问藤侍从。

en.t: so he went especially to the Naishi no Kami's residence to visit Fuji no Jiju.

units.source_text: 他从中门而入，看见一个同他一样穿便袍的男子站在那里。

en.t: He entered through the middle gate and saw a man standing there, dressed like himself in informal court robes.

units.source_text: 这人看见薰君进来，连忙躲避，却被薰君拉住了。

en.t: When the man saw Kaoru come in, he hurriedly tried to hide, but Kaoru caught hold of him.

units.source_text: 一看，原来是经常在这里徘徊的藏人少将。

en.t: Looking closer, Kaoru saw that it was the Chamberlain Lesser Captain who was often seen loitering there.

units.source_text: 他想：“正殿西边正在弹琵琶，奏琴筝，此人想是被音乐所迷而站在这里的吧。

en.t: He thought, "They are playing the biwa, koto, and zithers on the west side of the main hall, and this man must have been drawn here by the music.

units.source_text: 看他的样子真痛苦啊！

en.t: How painfully troubled he looks!

units.source_text: 对方不许而强欲求爱，是罪孽深重的！”

en.t: To force one's love on someone who does not permit it is a deeply sinful thing!"

units.source_text: 不久琴声停止。

en.t: Before long, the sound of the koto stopped.

units.source_text: 薰君对藏人少将说：“喂，请你引导吧，我是不熟悉的。”

en.t: Kaoru said to the Chamberlain Lesser Captain, "Come, please guide me. I do not know my way here."

units.source_text: 两人便联袂同行，唱着催马乐《梅枝》，向西面廊前的红梅树走去。

en.t: The two went on together, singing the saibara song "Plum Branch," and walked toward the red plum tree before the western gallery.

units.source_text: 薰君身上的香气比花香更浓，侍女们早就闻到，连忙打开边门，

en.t: Kaoru's fragrance was stronger than the scent of the blossoms, and the ladies had already noticed it, so they quickly opened the side door,

units.source_text: 用和琴合着《梅枝》的歌声，弹出美妙的音乐来。

en.t: and with a wagon they matched the singing of "Plum Branch," playing music of lovely beauty.

units.source_text: 薰君心念和琴是女子用的琴，不宜弹《梅枝》这吕调乐曲，而她们却弹得非常悦耳，

en.t: Kaoru thought that the wagon was a women's instrument and not suited to the ryo-mode music of "Plum Branch," yet they played it with extraordinary sweetness,

units.source_text: 便从头再唱一遍。

en.t: so he sang it again from the beginning.

units.source_text: 侍女们就用琵琶来伴奏，也弹得美妙无比。

en.t: The ladies then accompanied him on the biwa, and their playing too was surpassingly beautiful.

units.source_text: 薰君觉得这里的确富有风流佳趣，足以牵惹人情。

en.t: Kaoru felt that this place truly possessed elegant charm enough to stir anyone's heart.

units.source_text: 今夜他态度便随意不拘起来，也和她们调情说笑了。

en.t: That night he grew relaxed and unconstrained, and he flirted and joked with them as well.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍从帘内叫人送出一张和琴来。

en.t: Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, had someone send out a wagon from behind the blinds.

units.source_text: 薰君和藏人少将互相谦让，谁也不肯触手。

en.t: Kaoru and the Chamberlain Lesser Captain each deferred to the other, and neither would touch it.

units.source_text: 尚侍命侍女侍从君向薰君传言：“我早就闻知：你的爪音酷似已故的父亲大人。

en.t: The Naishi no Kami ordered the lady Jiju to convey a message to Kaoru: "I have long heard that the sound of your fingering closely resembles that of your late father.

units.source_text: 我真心希望听赏一下。

en.t: I sincerely wish to hear it for myself.

units.source_text: 今宵莺声引诱琴声，就请弹一曲吧。”

en.t: Tonight the warbler's voice invites the sound of the koto, so please play one piece."

units.source_text: 薰君心念此时怕羞退缩，甚不相宜，便勉勉强强地弹奏一曲，琴声实甚美妙。

en.t: Kaoru thought it would be most unsuitable to shrink back in embarrassment now, so he reluctantly played a piece, and the sound of the koto was truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏虽然是玉鬘尚侍的义父，但生前和她不常见面，况且现在早已不在人世，故玉鬘尚侍想起了他，不胜孺慕。

en.t: Although Genji had been Tamakazura's adoptive father, she had not often seen him while he lived, and now that he had long since left this world, she remembered him with unbearable filial longing.

units.source_text: 平日每逢小事细故，往往睹物怀人，何况今天听到薰君的琴声，自然更加感伤。

en.t: Even on ordinary days, the smallest things often made her remember the departed, and hearing Kaoru's koto today naturally moved her all the more deeply.

units.source_text: 她说：“大体看来，这薰君的相貌非常肖似已故的柏木大纳言呢。

en.t: She said, "Taken as a whole, Lord Kaoru's appearance very much resembles the late Major Counselor Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 听他的琴声，竟活像是大纳言弹出的。”

en.t: When I hear his koto, it is just as though the Major Counselor himself were playing."

units.source_text: 说罢就哭起来。

en.t: After saying this, she began to weep.

units.source_text: 她近来容易流泪，恐是年事渐老之相吧。

en.t: Lately she had become quick to tears, perhaps a sign that she was growing older.

units.source_text: 藏人少将也用美妙的嗓子唱“瓜瓞绵绵”之歌。

en.t: The Chamberlain Lesser Captain also sang the song of "Endless Gourd Vines" in a beautiful voice.

units.source_text: 座上没有唠叨多嘴的老人，诸公子自然互相劝诱，尽情表演。

en.t: With no talkative, nagging elders present, the young gentlemen naturally urged one another on and performed to their hearts' content.

units.source_text: 主人藤侍从想是肖似父亲髭黑大臣之故，对于此道不甚擅长，只解举杯劝酒。

en.t: The host, Fuji no Jiju, perhaps because he resembled his father, the Minister Higekuro, was not very skilled in such arts and knew only how to raise a cup and press wine on the guests.

units.source_text: 大家怂恿他：“你至少也该唱个祝词才行啊！”

en.t: Everyone urged him on, saying, "At the very least, you must sing a congratulatory verse!"

units.source_text: 他就跟着众人唱催马乐《竹河》。

en.t: So he joined the others in singing the saibara song "Takekawa."

units.source_text: 虽然还很幼稚，歌声也甚美妙。

en.t: Though it was still rather immature, his singing voice too was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 帘内送出一杯酒来。

en.t: A cup of wine was sent out from behind the blinds.

units.source_text: 薰君说道：“听说酒醉过分，心事隐忍不住，未免言语错乱。

en.t: Kaoru said, "I hear that when one becomes too drunk, hidden feelings can no longer be restrained, and one's words are apt to grow confused.

units.source_text: 教我怎么办呢？”

en.t: What would you have me do?"

units.source_text: 他不肯立刻接受酒杯。

en.t: He would not accept the cup at once.

units.source_text: 帘内送出一套妇人的褂子和礼服来，薰香浓郁可爱，这是临时应景，送与薰君的赏品。

en.t: From behind the blinds they sent out a set of women's robes and formal dress, charmingly steeped in rich fragrance; it was an impromptu seasonal prize for Kaoru.

units.source_text: 薰君诧异道：“这又是怎么一回事啊？”

en.t: Kaoru asked in surprise, "And what is the meaning of this?"

units.source_text: 便把两件衣衫推给藤侍从，起身就走。

en.t: He pushed the two garments toward Fuji no Jiju, rose, and started to leave.

units.source_text: 藤侍从拉住了他，将衣衫交还。

en.t: Fuji no Jiju stopped him and handed the garments back.

units.source_text: 薰君说：“我已经喝过‘水驿’酒，夜深了。”

en.t: Kaoru said, "I have already drunk the 'water station' wine, and the night is late."

units.source_text: 说着就逃回家去。

en.t: With that, he fled back home.

units.source_text: 藏人少将看见薰君常常来此，大家对他表示好感，便觉自己相形见绌，

en.t: Seeing that Kaoru came here often and that everyone showed him favor, the Chamberlain Lesser Captain felt himself put to shame by comparison,

units.source_text: 心中不胜委屈，口上不免说出无聊的怨言，吟诗道：

en.t: and, unable to bear the resentment in his heart, he could not help uttering petty complaints and recited a poem:
